learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose both mean and median against only mean and only median; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Initial boss50 gives mean40,median40. End on slider500 gives mean130,median40 and above four of five salaries feedback. Home50 restores40/40; End500 repeats130/40.
observations.reveal: Corrected only mean; computed(30+35+40+45+500)/5=130. Explained magnitude-sensitive sum versus unchanged middle rank,boss already last; median closer to typical person with few extremes.
observations.visual: Actual1257 ×936 dark screenshots inspected. Tall500 bar and mean130 line rise above four small salaries while dashed median40 stays. Full reveal and controls legible.

prediction.reason: Clear commitment separates average definitions under outlier change.

interaction.reason: Extreme and reset contrasts visibly isolate mean sensitivity.

payoff.reason: Connects observed lines to explicit sum and rank condition.

clarity.reason: Bar labels,two lines and paired counters clearly distinguish metrics.

transfer.reason: General extreme-value use condition but no concrete new application.
transfer.evidence: Median typical when few values extreme.

accessibility.reason: Slider endpoint keys only,insufficient access audit.
accessibility.evidence: Home/End work;focus order,contrast,phone,zoom and motion unknown.

surprise.reason: Committed both-shift prediction contradicted by invariant median.

visualExplanation.reason: Outlier bar and reference lines carry magnitude/rank distinction.

playfulness.reason: Reversible slider changes show repeatable effect.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete interpretation of typical salary central.
practicalValue.evidence: Mean exceeds four of five wages.

depth.reason: Sum versus order mechanisms and outlier condition linked.
depth.evidence: Explicit mean calculation and boss-last invariant.

complexity.reason: One supported contrast between total-based and middle-based average.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Compare sum magnitude with unchanged ordering,definitions supplied.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low: one labeled slider and two counters.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: low to moderate: mean/median definitions introduced.

whyCool: Raising one salary to500 pulls the mean above four workers while the median line stays exactly40.
caveat: Only highest salary changes; no crossing-rank or even-sized dataset boundary tested.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
